Fit the structured (age) nowcasting model with 'INLA'

Source: R/nowcasting_age_inla.R
nowcasting_age_inla.Rd

Fits the Bayesian negative binomial model with 'INLA' on data structured by age class and samples the posterior predictive trajectories. Data has to be in the delay-triangle format. Usually called internally by nowcasting_inla().

Usage

nowcasting_age_inla(
  dataset,
  zero_inflated = FALSE,
  timeREmodel = "rw2",
  INLAoutput = FALSE,
  INLAoutputOnly = FALSE,
  WAIC = FALSE,
  DIC = FALSE
)

Arguments

dataset

data pre formatted in to age classes and delays by week for each cases, delay triangle format

zero_inflated

Experimental! It deals with zero-inflated data by using a zeroinflatednbinomial2 model.

timeREmodel

Latent model for time random effects. The default is a second-order random walk model.

INLAoutput

return the INLA output. Default is FALSE.

INLAoutputOnly

return only the INLA output. Default is FALSE.

WAIC

return the WAIC. Default is FALSE.

DIC

return the DIC. Default is FALSE.

Value

A list with element 'sample', the posterior predictive trajectories by age class, and optionally the 'INLA' output.
